ROOT CAUSE LOG-ONLY: BETA ARCHITECT job failed ~4s after start: the workflow step 'curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 15 -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash' exited 1 with 'Failed to fetch version information'. The curl flags retry transport errors but the installer script itself fetched version metadata and failed without a retry wrapper at the step level (unlike agent invocations, which get 6 attempts via run-opencode-with-retry.sh). One transient installer failure therefore killed the entire cycle: architect produced nothing, builder/tester/auditor/director jobs skipped, and the persist step still force-pushed an empty cycle/product/32820217763/architect branch (= base tip). Single unguarded network dependency = whole-cycle kill switch.

~15 min total run wall clock for ~14 min of director value; architect consumed ~8s including checkout+worktree mounting of lab/graph@d41fe9b, lab/physics@d3afd9b, lab/intel@fca0acb before dying at the install step. No provider outages this run.
